summary: First-order RC circuit with current source Is, R1, R2 and capacitor: derive the differential equation for Vc(t), find the impulse response (ZSR), then use convolution to compute Vc for an input of two rectangular pulses, evaluate the ratio RES=Vc(0.5Δ)/Vc(1.5Δ) for different Δ/(R1C), and find the minimum Δ/(R1C) for which RES≥2 (pulse/information recovery).
